name: @pdpp/conformance-suite
description: Role-based executable conformance suite for PDPP Core v0.1 Section 9. Black-box and adapter-driven: every case speaks HTTP to a target through the TargetAdapter contract, so the same suite runs against any implementation. Produces a machine-readable report that distinguishes pass/fail/skip/unsupported/not-tested against the full Section 9 requirement denominator, and confers no status of any kind.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check && pnpm test
